// Serves /llms.txt for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and others).
// Gated to the main marketing hosts so the file never leaks the VoiceAI Connect
// identity onto agency white-label domains. Any other host receives a 404.

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

const MAIN_HOSTS = new Set([
  'myvoiceaiconnect.com',
  'www.myvoiceaiconnect.com',
]);

const LLMS_TXT = `# VoiceAI Connect

> VoiceAI Connect is a white-label AI receptionist platform for marketing agencies and resellers. Agencies brand the platform as their own, onboard local service businesses in under sixty seconds, and earn monthly recurring revenue while VoiceAI Connect operates the underlying voice, telephony, billing, and hosting infrastructure.

VoiceAI Connect is multi-tenant SaaS operated by Rocket Solutions LLC. An agency configures its brand (logo, colors, custom domain, transactional emails, and phone experience), then resells AI receptionist subscriptions to local businesses. Each end client receives their own branded dashboard with call recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, and appointment booking. Subscription payments route directly to the agency through Stripe Connect with no revenue share. VoiceAI Connect stays invisible to the businesses the agency serves.

Key facts:
- Audience: marketing agencies, local lead-generation agencies, and home-service agency operators who want to resell AI receptionists.
- Onboarding: a local business goes from signup to a live AI receptionist with a provisioned phone number in under 60 seconds. No A2P registration delay.
- Agency platform pricing: Free (no platform fee, usage-based per-client and per-minute rates), Pro ($99/mo), and Scale ($499/mo). End-client subscriptions are typically $99 to $299 per month, set by the agency.
- Capabilities: 24/7 AI voice answering, automatic English and Spanish with real-time language detection, real-time Google Calendar appointment booking, spam and robocall filtering, unlimited concurrent calls, call recordings and transcripts, per-client branded dashboards, a built-in lead-generation CRM, direct Stripe Connect payouts, and US plus international telephony (Telnyx and Twilio).
- Number continuity: clients forward their existing business number to the AI-provisioned number. This is call forwarding, not porting.
- Developer API: a Scale-plan REST API plus signed webhooks lets agencies read and manage clients, calls, appointments, and usage, and receive real-time call and booking events. See the Developer API section below.
- VoiceAI Connect is software infrastructure, not a course or coaching program. It is comparable to how Shopify is the operating system for an e-commerce business.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/): platform overview and agency earnings model.
- [Platform overview](https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/platform): full capability breakdown.
- [How it works](https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/how-it-works): the four-step setup process for agencies.
- [Pricing](https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/ai-receptionist-agency-pricing): agency plan tiers and per-usage rates.
- [FAQ](https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/faq): common questions about the platform.
- [Developer API & webhooks](https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/developers): REST API and webhook reference for agencies on the Scale plan.

## Guides and comparisons
- [What is a white-label AI receptionist?](https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/what-is-white-label-ai-receptionist)
- [How to start an AI receptionist agency](https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/how-to-start-ai-receptionist-agency)
- [How much can you make reselling AI receptionists?](https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/how-much-can-you-make-ai-receptionist-reseller)
- [White-label vs build your own](https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/white-label-vs-build-your-own)
- [Best white-label AI receptionist platforms](https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/best-white-label-ai-receptionist-platforms)

## Developer API & webhooks
Full reference with curl examples, worked JSON payloads, and integration recipes: https://www.myvoiceaiconnect.com/developers

- Base URL: https://urchin-app-bqb4i.ondigitalocean.app/api/v1
- Access: Scale plan only (call-center agencies get it on any plan; trialing agencies are treated as Scale). Below that, requests return 403 upgrade_required.
- Auth: an agency-scoped API key sent as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" (or "x-api-key: <key>"). Created in the dashboard under Settings, then API. The full key is shown once at creation.
- Scopes: read (all GET) and read_write (POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE).
- Rate limit: 120 requests per minute per key (X-RateLimit-* headers; 429 rate_limit_exceeded when exceeded).
- Pagination: list endpoints take ?limit (1-100, default 25) and ?cursor; a list returns { data, has_more, next_cursor }.
- Errors: { error: { type, message } }. Types include authentication_error, insufficient_scope, upgrade_required, account_suspended, not_found, invalid_request, rate_limit_exceeded, not_implemented, api_error.

REST endpoints (relative to the base URL):
- GET /account
- GET /clients, POST /clients, GET /clients/:id, PATCH /clients/:id, DELETE /clients/:id (not available yet; returns 501)
- GET /clients/:id/provisioning-status/:jobId
- GET and PATCH /clients/:id/receptionist
- GET and PUT /clients/:id/knowledge-base
- GET /calls, GET /calls/:id, GET /calls/:id/recording
- GET /clients/:id/availability?date=YYYY-MM-DD (open slots; needs a connected calendar)
- GET /appointments, GET /appointments/:id
- POST /appointments, PATCH /appointments/:id (reschedule), POST /appointments/:id/cancel
- GET /numbers, GET /usage, GET /analytics/calls
- GET /events, POST /webhooks, GET /webhooks, GET /webhooks/:id, PATCH /webhooks/:id, DELETE /webhooks/:id, GET /webhooks/:id/deliveries, POST /webhooks/:id/ping

Webhook events: call.started, call.completed, call.transferred, call.escalated, appointment.booked, appointment.rescheduled, appointment.canceled, client.provisioned, client.provisioning_failed, client.payment_failed, client.subscription_activated, client.trial_expired, client.canceled. Subscribe to specific events or ["*"].

Webhook signing: each delivery carries the header X-VoiceAI-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>, where v1 = HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + "." + rawBody). The secret (a whsec_ string) is returned once from POST /webhooks. Deliveries retry up to 6 times with backoff and expect a 2xx response. call.completed and call.transferred payloads are enriched with the full call, so no follow-up GET is needed.

Calendar booking: appointment writes (create via POST /appointments, reschedule, cancel) reach the client's connected calendar. Google Calendar is live now (real event write, availability-checked). Native writes for Outlook/Microsoft 365, Acuity, Calendly and Cal.com are being added through a calendar aggregator, and the appointment API is already provider-agnostic so they require no change to an integration. A client with no connected calendar gets a record-only appointment (a real row, no calendar event). The same applies to the AI booking on a call.

## Contact
- Support: support@myvoiceaiconnect.com
`;

export function GET(req: Request) {
  const host = (req.headers.get('host') || '').split(':')[0].toLowerCase();
  if (!MAIN_HOSTS.has(host)) {
    return new Response('Not found', { status: 404 });
  }
  return new Response(LLMS_TXT, {
    status: 200,
    headers: {
      'content-type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
      'cache-control': 'public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=86400',
    },
  });
}
